package.name: go2_webrtc_ros2
package.description: Unitree GO2 single-node ROS2 interface over one WebRTC connection (unitree_webrtc_connect): publishes sensor data as standard messages (PointCloud2, LaserScan, Imu, Image/CompressedImage, Odometry, JointState, BatteryState) and accepts motion control via standard topics (Twist velocity, String state/gait commands).
